name: Drag a file into a folder and wait for the upload
description: A white file card (dark film thumbnail, filename like 'raw_take_03.mov', size and length) sits below a dark folder icon with an orange upload arrow; a cursor grabs the file and drags it into the folder, where it shrinks away, then an upload card appears under the folder: 'Uploading…' with a percentage and an orange bar that crawls and stalls at a low number, plus an ETA.
use_when: Lines about uploading, sending or transferring footage (to a drive, the cloud, an editor or a client), or about slow steps before editing even starts: 'first you upload the video', 'wait for it to upload'.

filename.help: the file being dragged, with its extension

meta.help: length and size under the filename; '' hides it

folder_label.help: label under the folder, generic: 'Drive / uploads', 'Client / footage'

percent_to.help: 0-100: where the upload bar stops; keep it low (5-25) so it feels slow

eta.help: time left next to the bar, e.g. 'ETA 14 min', '2 h left'; '' hides it
